WITH circuit_races AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as race_count 
  FROM races 
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    CAST(race_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share,
    CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races) as avg_share
  FROM circuit_races
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share as excess
  FROM with_share
  WHERE share > avg_share
),
tenth_excess AS (
  SELECT excess 
  FROM above_avg 
  ORDER BY excess DESC 
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  race_count,
  share,
  excess
FROM above_avg
WHERE excess >= (SELECT excess FROM tenth_excess)
ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId
